title: T113 (Tinyana) PNC - For One Who HaShem Shines To — Even One Slight Lack of Sheleimus Should Consume the Nefesh
hebrewTitle: מי שמתנוצץ לו ה' — ראוי שתכלה נפשו אפילו על דבר אחד שלא נעשה בתכלית הקדושה
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Mi she-rak misnotzeitz lo HaShem yisbarach, k'she-oseh, chas ve-shaloim, afilu davar echad she-loi ka-ra'oui bi-shleimus** *(kelomar, af-al-pi she-ein ba-zeh davar shum nidnud aveirah, chas ve-shaloim, ve-loi shum ta'avah gemurah be-gashmiyus, rak she-eino oseh ha-davar be-tachlis sheleimus ha-kedushah ka-ra'oui be-emes)* — **ra'ui lo she-tichleh nafsho le-gamrei me-etzem ha-charatah ve-ha-bushah.** **Le-mi atzelu hu omer**: not to the rasha mid-aveirah; *to the one who has merited that HaShem yisbarach is even *misnotzeitz* to him* — *to him* the standard is *tachlis ha-sheleimus*. *Davar echad she-eino bi-shleimus ha-kedushah ka-ra'oui be-emes* — *ra'ui she-tichleh nafsho me-etzem ha-charatah ve-ha-bushah*. The *measure of sensitivity is calibrated to the measure of giluy you have already received*. *Lo deviation, ein kan she-shaiyach*; **chesron sheleimus, kan dayka shaiyach.**

intermediate.en: **Mi she-misnotzeitz lo HaShem yisbarach**: *afilu davar echad she-eino bi-tachlis sheleimus ha-kedushah ka-ra'oui — ra'ui she-tichleh nafsho me-etzem ha-charatah ve-ha-bushah*. *Lo davar shel aveirah ve-lo ta'avah be-gashmiyus — chesron sheleimus le-vad*. **Hera'ayah**: ha-amidah le-fi midas ha-giluy.

scholarly.he: [T2:113א] למי שה' מתנוצץ אליו — אפילו פגם בשלמות קדושה (לא נדנוד עברה) — ראוי שתכלה נפשו מהחרטה והבושה. מידת הרגישות = מידת ההתנוצצות.
